title: Before You Count 2% Cash Back, Check Where It Has to Go
caption:
Fidelity’s 2% comes with a destination. The Fidelity Rewards Visa Signature’s advertised value applies when you redeem points into an eligible Fidelity account—don’t assume statement credits deliver the same value.

The catch: the receiving account must already be open and funded. Verify your exact account registration before applying; IRA and 529 deposits also have contribution restrictions.

Already want rewards deposited there? This approach can fit. Prefer statement credits? Check their redemption value first.

Card details: practicalrewards.com/card-pages/fidelity-rewards-visa-signature.html

Choose the destination first; count the rewards second.
